name: ravelry-mcp
description: Find knitting and crochet patterns, yarns, yarn substitutes and local yarn shops on Ravelry.
long_description: Lets Claude search Ravelry patterns by category, yarn weight, yardage, difficulty, fit, language and designer; read full pattern details (yarn, gauge, needles, sizes, notes); search yarns by weight, fiber and attributes; find the yarns other knitters actually used for a pattern; and find local yarn shops. Requires a free read-only API key pair from https://www.ravelry.com/pro/developer.

ravelry_username.title: Ravelry API username
ravelry_username.description: The "username" of a read-only (basic auth) app created at https://www.ravelry.com/pro/developer. This is not your Ravelry login.

ravelry_password.title: Ravelry API password
ravelry_password.description: The "password" of the same read-only app.

tools.name: search_patterns
tools.description: Search patterns by keyword, category, yarn weight, yardage, difficulty, fit, techniques, language, designer and price.

tools.name: get_pattern_details
tools.description: Yarn, gauge, needles, sizes and notes for up to 20 patterns at once.

tools.name: search_yarns
tools.description: Search yarns by name, weight, fiber and attributes such as superwash or hand-dyed.

tools.name: get_yarn_details
tools.description: Fiber content, needles, gauge, care and origin for up to 20 yarns.

tools.name: find_yarns_for_pattern
tools.description: Yarn substitution: the yarns other knitters used for a pattern, most used first.

tools.name: find_yarn_shops
tools.description: Find local yarn shops near a location or by name or city.

tools.name: match_yarns
tools.description: Match yarns read from a ball band, receipt or invoice to Ravelry yarns.

tools.name: adjust_for_gauge
tools.description: Compare your swatch with a pattern's gauge and recalculate its numbers.

tools.name: spread_evenly
tools.description: Spread increases or decreases evenly across a row or round.

tools.name: yarn_needed
tools.description: How many skeins of a yarn to buy for a pattern.

tools.name: count_stitches
tools.description: Check the stitch counts of written rows and rounds.

tools.name: crafting_reference
tools.description: Needle and hook sizes, yarn weights, US/UK terms and abbreviations.
